acquisition_method.evidence: MS/MS spectra were acquired in data-dependent mode, after Higher Energy Collisional Dissociation (HCD) fragmentation, at a resolution of 17,500 (Olsen et al. 2009, Mol. Cell. Proteomics).

cleavage_agent.evidence: 25 to 40 micro-g of protein were mixed in equimolar amounts with the isotopicaly labelled protein standard (Geiger et al 2010. Nature Methods) and trypsin digested following the Filter-Aid Sample Preparation (FASP) methodology (Ostasiewicz et al. 2010, J. Proteome Res)

fractionation_method.evidence: The resulting peptides were fractionated by Strong Anion Exchange chromatography (SAX) into five fractions to reduce sample complexity and maximize depth of proteome coverage.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS/MS spectra were acquired in data-dependent mode, after Higher Energy Collisional Dissociation (HCD) fragmentation, at a resolution of 17,500 (Olsen et al. 2009, Mol. Cell. Proteomics).

labeling.evidence: Protein extracts of SILAC (heavy Arg10, Lys8) labelled LNCaP, PC-3, 22rv1 and WPMY-1 cells lines of prostatic origin were mixed in a 27:27:27:19 ratio and used as spike-in standard.

mass_analyzer.evidence: MS spectra acquired in the Orbitrap with 70,000 resolution.
